packages.name: annotated-types
packages.rationale: Provides reusable type constraints for Pydantic.

packages.name: attrs
packages.rationale: Provides immutable data structures used by jsonschema and referencing.

packages.name: jsonschema
packages.rationale: Validates runtime payloads against the shared JSON Schema contracts.

packages.name: jsonschema-specifications
packages.rationale: Provides the JSON Schema meta-schemas used by jsonschema.

packages.name: numpy
packages.rationale: Provides the array and numerical primitives for geometry. The release metadata also lists 0BSD, MIT, Zlib and CC0-1.0 for bundled code.

packages.name: opencv-python-headless
packages.rationale: Provides the Apache-2.0 OpenCV camera and geometry routines with MIT-licensed packaging scripts. Upstream wheels bundle LGPL-2.1 FFmpeg, which has separate redistribution obligations.

packages.name: pydantic
packages.rationale: Enforces strict typed models at motion-engine boundaries.

packages.name: pydantic-core
packages.rationale: Provides the validation and serialization engine used by Pydantic.

packages.name: referencing
packages.rationale: Resolves references between the registered JSON Schema contracts.

packages.name: rpds-py
packages.rationale: Provides persistent data structures used by referencing and jsonschema.

packages.name: scipy
packages.rationale: Provides numerical routines for interpolation and signal filtering.

packages.name: typing-extensions
packages.rationale: Provides portable typing features required by the runtime validation stack.

packages.name: typing-inspection
packages.rationale: Provides the runtime type inspection used by Pydantic.
